objectives: Connect microscopic models to continuum field descriptions.
Understand universality and scale dependence near critical points.

outcomes.statement: Construct field theories for equilibrium statistical systems.
Apply renormalisation-group ideas to phase transitions.

syllabus.title: Fields and Phase Transitions
syllabus.topics: Order parameters, Landau theory, correlation functions and fluctuations.

syllabus.title: Functional Methods
syllabus.topics: Path integrals, generating functionals and Gaussian field theory.

syllabus.title: Renormalisation Group
syllabus.topics: Scaling, universality, coarse graining, fixed points and critical exponents.
